## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record whether an asset is accessible without payment ([schema:isAccessibleForFree](https://schema.org/isAccessibleForFree)) — the free/paywalled signal for a work or dataset.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with the licence (a freely-accessible work may still be all-rights-reserved — use [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md) for the terms) and avoid it for access conditions, which are [`gmeow:conditionsOfAccess`](gmeow-conditionsOfAccess.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:isAccessibleForFree`](gmeow-isAccessibleForFree.md) to a boolean on the asset; pair false with [`gmeow:acquireLicensePage`](gmeow-acquireLicensePage.md) for the purchase route, and keep the licence terms on [`gmeow:hasLicense`](gmeow-hasLicense.md).

### Examples

- ex:openArticle [`gmeow:isAccessibleForFree`](gmeow-isAccessibleForFree.md) true.
